text: Noise: the sound pressure level shall not exceed 85 dB(A) at 1 m from the valve and the pipe (ER-14.03, DP-CASE-0044) in normal operation, calculated per IEC 60534-8-3 (aerodynamic) and IEC 60534-8-4 (hydrodynamic) without credit for insulation unless specified as part of the supply; low-noise trim, multistage trim, diffusers or a series of valves where the calculated level is higher; the manufacturer shall guarantee the level and measure it in the performance test when required.
